text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: Commander Genius is an open-source engine recreation project designed to run the classic Commander Keen games on modern systems. It improves compatibility while preserving the original side-scrolling platform gameplay, graphics, and level design. The engine adds features such as improved controls, widescreen support, save functionality, and support for multiple Commander Keen episodes. It serves as a modern way to experience one of the influential MS-DOS platform game series.
